latin_text: In the first world, God, the primal unity, presides over nine orders of angels as if over as many spheres and, without moving, moves all toward himself.
english_translation: In the first world, God, the primal unity, presides over nine orders of angels as if over as many spheres and, without moving, moves all toward himself.
exegesis: Parallel structure: God governs nine angelic orders in the intelligible world just as the empyrean presides over nine celestial spheres and prime matter over nine spheres of forms in the sublunary world.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.SP.3 | Nine orders of angels; angelic spheres as mirrors of celestial and elemental orders
